title: Coding on the go with Claude Code
format_note: Presenter-led tutorial intercutting on-camera talk with animated diagrams and scripted screen recordings of a fictional Acme bug fix.
one_thing: A cloud session keeps working after you close the laptop, so you can hand off a task, answer Claude from your phone and review it later.

transcript.voice_style: Calm, conversational on-camera presenter; short declarative sentences; second-person instructions; no hype words.
transcript.script_shape: Promise demo in 15 s, define the term, when to use it, setup steps, environments, limits, worked bug-fix example, handoff variants, docs pointer.

structure.frame0: Presenter smiling at a desk, half-faded under a ghost of the task-input UI mid-dissolve (f0001.jpg); a person is the subject, not black or a logo.
structure.first_3s: 'Watch this.' then the task typed into the desktop app (t=1.0-3.6), then presenter closes laptop; the promise is spoken at t=1-5 and shown on screen.

hero_moment.what: Phone shows Claude's question 'The footer has a second sign-up form with the same check. Should I fix both?' while the laptop is asleep (f0005.jpg-f0007.jpg).

ending.what: Presenter closes with a smile and the docs URL chip over the last 4 s; no logo or end card.

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: Cuts follow spoken sentences; presenter and graphic shots alternate. Diagram cards add one per spoken item inside a shot; one 26.7 s phone shot holds (t=201-228). No burst.

look.accent_use: Coral marks Claude only: the asterisk glyph, send button and status dots; blue appears only inside the recorded GitHub banner (f0040.jpg).
look.type: Serif display for titles and chapter labels, geometric sans for diagram cards and UI, monospace for code and diff lines; titles are sentence case.

good.observation: The film shows its own promise first: task typed, laptop closed, phone question, all inside 15 s, matching the spoken 'Watch this.'
Diagrams add one card per spoken item, so the picture and the sentence arrive together and the same labels return across scenes.
One consistent visual system: cream ground, coral only for Claude, serif titles, sans cards. It reads as one brand across 4 minutes.
A single worked example (newsletter form accepts 'ada@example') threads the desktop, phone, diff and PR steps, so every feature is shown on one story.
Chapter labels in the lower third mark each topic change in 3-5 words, six times, so a scrubber can navigate the film.
Loudness is on the social target with headroom: -14.2 LUFS and -1.4 dBTP on a voice-only mix.

weak.observation: Whole-screen product shots are too small to read: GitHub install page text is about 12 px and the t=8 phone mock text about 12 px, under 2.6% of height.
The error message after Subscribe is a muted pink on cream, easy to miss at the one moment the bug is shown.
Static stretches are long: 32.5% of sampled intervals are static and the longest static run is 10 s ending t=170, with a 26.7 s single shot at t=201-228.
Frame 0 is a mid-dissolve of presenter over UI ghost, flagged not-evidence by the prescan, so the first frame is murky rather than a clean poster.

rule_candidates.rule: In a talk-led explainer, build the diagram one card per spoken item and keep a landed title static while chips append beneath it.
rule_candidates.evidence: t=43-70: title static 27 s while 3 chips add at about 56, 58, 64 s.

rule_candidates.rule: For tutorials and feature explainers, allow shots of 5-6 s median and cuts near 8 per minute; the 1.8-3.5 s launch cadence does not apply when narration carries the content.
A 3-frame (0.125 s) cross-dissolve is acceptable between on-camera footage and graphics when the topic changes; keep it under 0.2 s so it reads as a cut.
rule_candidates.evidence: strips/window-12-18.875s.jpg: blend only at f455; 20 of 32 seams.

rule_candidates.rule: Crop screen recordings to the active control so UI text is above 2.6% of frame height; show the whole device only as an establishing shot of 2 s or less.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0087.jpg question text about 5% height versus f0005.jpg about 1.7%.

rule_candidates.rule: Label each topic change on presenter shots with a 2-5 word serif lower third at about 4% of frame height, one per 20-40 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: 6 labels at t=19, 42, 70, 100, 172, 200; measured 29 px of 720 on the title.

rule_candidates.rule: Run one fictional worked example through every UI scene (same repo, same bug, same PR) so each feature appears as a step in one story.
rule_candidates.evidence: Acme newsletter bug t=1-228; PR #128 at t=204.

rule_candidates.rule: Voice-only explainers hit -14 LUFS with true peak at -1.4 dBTP and a 2 LU range; no music bed is needed when speech carries the pace.
Make a stylised cursor with a tap ripple and motion blur the single actor in recorded UI, and move it only on the word it illustrates.
rule_candidates.evidence: f0040.jpg blurred hand; f0102.jpg grey tap circle on close button.
